    function mergeSettingsNotes()
    end
    function [ok,message]=labcams_ephys(command)
        assert(strcmp(command,'stop') && ChipmunkShutdownTest.recording);
        if ~strcmp(ChipmunkShutdownTest.failure,'save')
            checkpoint=load(BpodSystem.Path.CurrentDataFile{1});
            assert(checkpoint.SessionData.nTrials==3);
            assert(contains(fileread(fullfile(fileparts(BpodSystem.Path.CurrentDataFile{1}),'notes.txt')),'test note'));
        end
        ChipmunkShutdownTest.events{end+1}='camera';ok=true;message='';
    end
    function PsychToolboxSoundServer(command)
        assert(strcmp(command,'Close') && ChipmunkShutdownTest.recording);
        ChipmunkShutdownTest.events{end+1}='sound';
        if strcmp(ChipmunkShutdownTest.failure,'sound'),error('Test:Sound','Sound close failed');end
    end
    function SpikeGLXControl(command)
        assert(strcmp(command,'shutdown'));
    end
    function state=spikeglx_client(command)
        assert(strcmp(command,'shutdown'));
        ChipmunkShutdownTest.events{end+1}='ephys';ChipmunkShutdownTest.recording=false;
        state=struct('actionLog',{{'Stopped'}},'lastError','');
    end
